title: Barbu: Learn Card Games
shortDescription: Learn Hearts, Gin Rummy and more. Add Canasta with optional Premium.
fullDescription:
Learn here. Play together.

Learn a new card game before joining a real table. Barbu combines short interactive lessons, guided hands and single-player practice against computer opponents.

SEVEN FREE TABLES
Your existing games and their current Learn and Play content stay free, without ads or timers:
- Hearts: passing, penalty cards and shooting the moon.
- Gin Rummy: drawing, discarding, melds, deadwood, knocking and gin.
- Spades: partnership bids, nil and bags.
- Whist: trumps and partnership trick-taking.
- Bridge: bidding, contracts, declarer and dummy play.
- Barbu: a seven-contract training session, including Domino.
- Card Counting I: exercises in remembering played cards.

LEARN BY MAKING DECISIONS
Choose cards, see feedback and learn why a move works. Follow a learning path, revisit a topic or open Game rules when you need a reference. Guided hands explain decisions as you play. Local saves let you return to an unfinished game.

OPTIONAL BARBU PREMIUM
An optional monthly or yearly subscription adds Modern American Canasta: four-player partnership games against computer opponents, eight learning topics and guided hands. Learn card values, melds, opening requirements, meld risk, taking the discard pile, discarding, going out and scoring.

Premium is not required for the seven free tables. Subscription availability varies by country. Google Play shows the local price and billing period before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled through Google Play. Premium needs an internet connection when you reopen Barbu to verify access.

TAKE YOUR SKILLS TO A REAL TABLE
Share Barbu with a friend, or use Get out and play to open Google Maps and search for nearby card clubs. Results come from Google Maps, not a verified Barbu directory.

Barbu is single-player. It does not offer online multiplayer, club membership or tournament booking. Local groups may use different rules and conventions; check with your table before playing.
